forum.bumped_alert: Bumped to the top of the list.
forum.wait_title: It was active too recently, or you have used your bumps for now.
forum.left_title: {count, plural, one {# bump left in the next 24 hours} other {# bumps left in the next 24 hours}}

schedule.title: Plan bumps
schedule.every_help: At least {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} apart.
schedule.limits_help: Planned bumps count towards your bumps for the day. When it is too soon, that bump is skipped and the next one goes ahead.

settings.cooldown_help: How long a discussion must go without replies or bumps before its owner can bump it. 0 for no cooldown.
settings.daily_help: How many bumps a member can make in any 24 hours, across all their discussions. 0 for no limit.
settings.log_days_help: Older entries are removed. 0 keeps them all. Daily limits always see the last 24 hours.

groups.label: Limits per group
groups.help: Leave a box blank to use the default above (shown in grey). A member in several groups gets the most generous value of each. Groups that can bump any discussion have no limits.

tags.label: Tags members can bump in
tags.help: Tick none to allow every tag. Moderators can bump in any tag.

permissions.bump_any: Bump any discussion, plan bumps and see the bump log (no limits)

api.too_soon: This discussion can't be bumped yet. It was active too recently, or you've used your bumps for now.
api.plan_at: Pick a time between now and a year from now.
api.plan_every_cooldown: Repeats must be at least {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} apart.
api.plan_times: Repeat 1 to 999 times, or leave it blank.
api.plan_at_cooldown: That's too soon after its last activity. Pick a later time.
